NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
2144 West Potomac
From RT-4 to RM-5

The Property

The property is improved with two separate buildings, a front building containing three dwelling units two of
which are legal and the third being officially classified as a commercial space and a rear two-story building with
basement containing two legal units the lower one being duplexed into the basement, and no parking. The
subject block is generally zoned RT-4 with an RM4.5 district approximately one block north on North Leavitt
Street and an RM-6 district two-thirds of a block east at the northeast corner of West Potomac Avenue and
North Hoyne Avenue. The property is within the Wicker Park Landmark District. The neighborhood is
generally improved with one to three story single-family and multi-family buildings, some of which also
contain separate rear buildings with residential units. The property is a Transit Served Location per the Transit
Oriented Provisions of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, Section 17-10-0102-B (1), as it is within 695 feet of the
Division Street CTA Bus Line Corridor Roadway Segment and 1,945 feet from the Damen CTA Blue Line
Train Station.

The Project

The Applicant proposes to legalize the existing residential unit in the former commercial space on the ground
floor of the front building and divide the duplexed unit in the rear building into separate units. After this
work, the property will have three units in each of the front and rear buildings for a total of six residential
dwelling units. No additions or other expansions to either building is proposed. No parking exists or will be
added. The existing height of the buildings is and will remain at 37.1 feet for the front building and 29.0 feet for
the rear building. As part of the application, the Applicant seeks all relief as needed as allowed by the
Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans, including: 1) parking reduction under the TSL provisions from six
spaces to zero per 17-13-1003-EE; 2) reduction in setbacks with front setback from 15.0 feet to zero, side
setbacks from 2.0/3.0 feet individually and 5.0 feet combined to 0 individual and 3 ft. 7 in combined and rear
setback from 39.6 feet to zero per 17-13-1101-B; and 3) reduction in the rear yard open space from 216 square
feet to zero per 17-13-1003-K and 17-13-1101-A.
